name: Geometry Shader Voxel Cube Generation with Face Culling
definition: A technique to render voxel cubes by generating geometry from point primitives using a geometry shader. It uses an alpha channel value in the vertex color to determine which of the six cube faces to generate, allowing for occlusion culling of faces adjacent to other cubes.
summary: This GPU technique renders voxel cubes by generating triangle geometry from point primitives and selectively emitting only non-occluded faces using an alpha bitmask.
